== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese explicitly says he is not a smuggler; the English says he may make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. The Japanese lore calls him an unlicensed pilot and an unqualified starship technician, rather than the English “Rogue pilot” and “Outlaw starship tech,” and shortens Obi-Wan Kenobi to Obi-Wan. Publication ID 1301_4o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending. Photo and English-face references are inline.
